Bihar Teachers Dress Code : bihar men sarkari shikshakon ke dres kod ko lekar shiksha vibhag ne phir se nirdesh jari kiya hai. sarkari shikshakon ke lie dres kod anivary kiya gaya hai. jins aur ti-shart pahanne par pahle se lagu rok ka karaee se palan karne ko kaha gaya hai.
Shiksha mantri ke nirdesh par vibhagiy patr jari huaa hai. aakhir shikshakon ke lie kya hai naya nirdesh aur kin niymon ka karna hoga palan? dekhie is riport men puri jankari.
